brief:
Create a draft survey in English from the instrument below for team Field Alpha. Preserve wording, order, choices, and conditional display. Keep setup notes hidden. Use the neutral respondent-facing title below. Retain Q2. Place the price reveal on a new page AFTER submitting Q5. If any feature is unsupported, report it. Proposed pre-launch close Nov 18, 2026 at 11:59 PM America/New_York; tell us if automatic closing is supported. Return the survey ID, conversation ID, draft preview if available, and any limitations. Stop at draft; do not publish, distribute, email, recruit or run personas.

Use the title, introduction and question wording below. Instructions in square brackets are for setup and must not appear to respondents.

Title: Video game purchase plans

Introduction:
A short survey about video games and purchase plans. Please answer based on your own circumstances. Choose one answer unless stated otherwise.

1. Which of these gaming devices do you currently own?

   Select all that apply.

   - PlayStation 5, including PS5 Pro
   - PlayStation 4
   - Xbox Series X or Series S
   - Xbox One
   - Nintendo Switch or Switch 2
   - A gaming desktop or laptop
   - Another gaming device
   - None of these

   ["None of these" is exclusive. Continue only if PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X or Series S is selected. Randomize the named devices if supported; keep "Another gaming device" and "None of these" last. Use a generic screen-out message without identifying the qualifying devices.]

2. Are you 18 or older and currently living in the United States?

   - Yes
   - No

   [End the survey if "No." Omit this question only if Flashpoint already verifies both age and current US residence; renumber the remaining questions.]

[Show after screening:]
The remaining questions are about GTA VI, scheduled for release on November 19, 2026. In this survey, "launch week" means November 19-25.

3. Before starting this survey, which best described your plans for GTA VI?

   If you currently hold a pre-order, choose one of the first three answers.

   - I had pre-ordered Standard
   - I had pre-ordered Ultimate
   - I had pre-ordered, but I wasn't sure which edition
   - I planned to pre-order or buy during launch week
   - I planned to buy after launch week at the regular price
   - I was waiting for a discount
   - I did not plan to buy
   - I had not decided

4. What is the most you would be willing to pay for a new copy of the Standard Edition, before tax?

   All amounts are in US dollars.

   - Less than $40
   - $40-$59.99
   - $60-$69.99
   - $70-$79.99
   - $80-$99.99
   - $100 or more
   - I would not buy the Standard Edition at any price
   - Not sure

5. Before starting this survey, which US launch prices for GTA VI did you already know?

   - Both the Standard and Ultimate prices
   - The Standard price only
   - The Ultimate price only
   - Neither price
   - Not sure

[Show only after Questions 3-5 have been submitted. If supported, prevent respondents from going back to edit those answers after seeing the prices.]

The US launch prices before tax are:
Standard Edition: $79.99
Ultimate Edition: $99.99

6. At these prices, what do you plan to do?

   If you plan to keep a pre-order unchanged, choose the first answer. Otherwise, choose the answer that best describes your plan.

   - Keep my existing pre-order and edition
   - Place or change a pre-order, or buy during launch week, at the listed price
   - Buy after launch week at the listed price
   - Wait for a discount
   - Not buy the game
   - Not sure

   [Show the same answers to everyone. Do not add a separate pre-order branch.]

7. What is the main reason for the purchase plan you just selected?

   - I want to play as soon as the game comes out
   - The price or my budget
   - I am waiting for reviews or feedback from other players
   - I do not have time to play yet
   - I am not interested enough to buy
   - I would rather play on another platform
   - Something else: ______
   - Not sure

   [Randomize the first six answers if supported. Keep "Something else" and "Not sure" last.]

8. How would you describe the $79.99 price of the Standard Edition?

   - Very low
   - Somewhat low
   - About right
   - Somewhat high
   - Very high
   - Not sure

9. Before this survey, had the prices you already knew about led you to change your plans for GTA VI?

   Select all that apply.

   - I had decided to buy later than I originally planned
   - I had decided to wait for a discount
   - I had changed my planned purchase from Ultimate to Standard
   - I had decided not to buy after previously planning to buy
   - I had decided to buy sooner than I originally planned
   - I had made another change: ______
   - The prices had not changed my plans
   - Not sure

   [Show only if Question 5 indicates awareness of at least one price: its first three answers. The last two answers are each exclusive. If conditional display is unavailable, show this question to everyone and add the exclusive answer "Not applicable - I did not know either price before this survey." Use Question 5 to determine eligibility for the history analysis.]

10. Have you played a GTA game before, including GTA Online?

   - Yes
   - No
   - Not sure

[End message:]
Thank you for taking part.
